test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User has valid username and password
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with empty username
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message indicating username is required, password field is cleared, and username remains

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with empty password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message indicating password is required, password field is cleared, and username remains

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with invalid credentials
preconditions: User has invalid username and/or password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message indicating invalid credentials, password field is cleared, and username remains

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with maximum length username and password
preconditions: User has a username and password of maximum allowed length
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with special characters in username and password
preconditions: User has a username and password containing special characters
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Accessing Dashboard after successful login
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Click on 'Dashboard' link in the navigation bar
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard is displayed with personalized greeting and blocks

test_cases.test_case: Viewing My Courses page
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Click on 'My Courses' link in the navigation bar
test_cases.expected_result: My Courses page is displayed with all courses as visual cards

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to access Dashboard without logging in
preconditions: User is not logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard URL directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Toggling Edit mode on Dashboard
preconditions: User is logged in
test_cases.expected_result: Edit mode is activated, showing additional options

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to add a block without Edit mode
preconditions: User is logged in and Edit mode is off
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add a block' button
test_cases.expected_result: User cannot add a block, and no action is performed

test_cases.test_case: Adding a block in Edit mode
preconditions: User is logged in and Edit mode is on
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add a block' button
2. Select a block type from the list
test_cases.expected_result: Selected block is added to the Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to add a block and canceling
preconditions: User is logged in and Edit mode is on
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add a block' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Dashboard without adding a block

test_cases.test_case: Navigating to Course page from My Courses
preconditions: User is logged in and has courses
steps: 1. Click on a course name link from My Courses
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the selected Course page

test_cases.test_case: Viewing Course content in collapsible sections
preconditions: User is logged in and on a Course page
steps: 1. Click on a section's chevron to expand it
test_cases.expected_result: The section expands to show activities and resources

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to access Course page without permissions
preconditions: User is logged in but does not have access to the course
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page URL directly
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating lack of permissions

test_cases.test_case: Creating an assignment successfully
preconditions: User is logged in and in Edit mode on a Course page
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add an activity or resource' button
test_cases.expected_result: Assignment is created and user is redirected to the Course page

test_cases.test_case: Creating an assignment with missing required fields
preconditions: User is logged in and in Edit mode on a Course page
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add an activity or resource' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message indicating Assignment name is required, and user remains on the creation form

test_cases.test_case: Creating an assignment with maximum length name
preconditions: User is logged in and in Edit mode on a Course page
steps: 1. Click on '+ Add an activity or resource' button
test_cases.expected_result: Assignment is created and user is redirected to the Course page

test_cases.test_case: Editing an existing assignment
preconditions: User is logged in and in Edit mode on a Course page with an existing assignment
steps: 1. Click on the three-dot menu of the existing assignment
test_cases.expected_result: Assignment is updated with new details and user is redirected to the Course page

test_cases.test_case: Deleting an assignment
preconditions: User is logged in and in Edit mode on a Course page with an existing assignment
steps: 1. Click on the three-dot menu of the existing assignment
test_cases.expected_result: Assignment is deleted and no longer appears on the Course page

test_cases.test_case: Viewing the Gradebook Grader report
preconditions: User is logged in and has access to the Gradebook
steps: 1. Click on 'Grades' from the user menu
test_cases.expected_result: Grader report is displayed with grades for all students

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to access Gradebook without permissions
preconditions: User is logged in but does not have access to the Gradebook
steps: 1. Navigate to the Gradebook URL directly
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating lack of permissions

test_cases.test_case: Logging out successfully
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to access a protected page after logout
preconditions: User is logged out
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard URL directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Editing profile with maximum length fields
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit profile page
steps: 1. Fill in all fields with maximum allowed length
test_cases.expected_result: Profile is updated successfully and user is redirected to the Profile page

test_cases.test_case: Editing profile with invalid email format
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit profile page
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message indicating invalid email format, and user remains on the Edit profile page

test_cases.test_case: Viewing Profile page
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
test_cases.expected_result: Profile page is displayed with user details

test_cases.test_case: Viewing Profile with no additional names or interests
preconditions: User is logged in and has no additional names or interests
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
test_cases.expected_result: Profile page displays without additional names or interests sections

test_cases.test_case: Attempting to edit profile without required fields
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Edit profile page
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error messages indicating required fields are missing, and user remains on the Edit profile page
